title: CLI docs for scripts and agents, and steadier request streams and pages
items: The CLI docs describe whk's JSON output, its exit statuses and error codes, whk wait and whk api
The interactive TUI is gone from the docs: whk prints its commands when run on its own
A live stream (whk listen, whk wait) no longer misses a request that finished saving after a newer one had already been sent
Paging through requests (API, SDKs, CLI, MCP) no longer skips or repeats a request when others arrive or are deleted in between
